schema.description: An error response, following RFC 9457 (Problem Details for HTTP APIs, which obsoletes RFC 7807). Returned with `Content-Type: application/problem+json` on every 4xx/5xx response. The HTTP status line carries the status code; it is intentionally not repeated in the body. `type`, `title` and `instance` are always present; `detail` is included when a specific explanation is available.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.
detail.example: dev-id or x-api-key headers are missing

instance.description: The request path, including any query string, that produced this problem.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type (the lowercased HTTP status text).

type.description: A URI reference identifying the problem type. Defaults to `about:blank`.

400.description: One or more parameters is malformed. The `detail` field describes the specific problem.

parameters.description: Filter by your external reference ID.
parameters.name: reference_id

parameters.description: Filter by upload handle — returns every report from that upload.
parameters.name: upload_id

parameters.description: Lab report date lower bound (inclusive, ISO-8601 `YYYY-MM-DD`).
parameters.name: report_date_from

parameters.description: Lab report date upper bound (inclusive, ISO-8601 `YYYY-MM-DD`).
parameters.name: report_date_to

items.description: A lab report session. Returned in full on retrieve; list items carry the summary fields only (no results/panels).

collection_date.description: Specimen collection date (YYYY-MM-DD); omitted if not extracted.

collection_time.description: Specimen collection time (HH:MM, 24-hour); omitted if not extracted.

current_status.description: Current status as a clean lowercase string (open enum), e.g. processing, sent, partially_sent, failed.

panels.description: Report-level panels that results reference by panel_id. Omitted if the report has no panel grouping.

items.description: A report-level grouping that results reference by panel_id.

key.description: Normalized dedup key (deterministic text, not a LOINC code).

name.description: Verbatim panel header as printed on the report.

patient_age_at_collection.description: Patient age in years; omitted if unknown.

patient_sex.description: Clean lowercase string (open enum); omitted if unspecified.

reference_id.description: Your external reference; omitted if not set.

report_date.description: Date printed on the report (YYYY-MM-DD); omitted if not extracted.

report_time.description: Time printed on the report (HH:MM, 24-hour); omitted if not extracted.

report_type.description: Report type as a clean lowercase string (open enum — handle unknown values gracefully).

results.description: The layered biomarker results. Populated on retrieve, not on list.

items.description: One layered result: verbatim source, normalized biomarker identity, one typed measurement, and the interpretation. measurement and interpretation are byte-identical to the webhook payload.

key.description: Canonical biomarker slug, or null when unmatched — the sole no-match signal. Do not key off loinc_code, which can be null on a match.

loinc_code.description: LOINC code; omitted when the matched biomarker has no LOINC mapping.

panel_id.description: References panels[].id on the enclosing session.

applied_range.description: Bounds of the reference range the flag was judged against.

flag.description: Coded signal (high/low/normal), or null when there is no signal.

source.description: Provenance of flag — report, computed, or none.

measurement.description: The single typed value of a result. Exactly one value field is set, named by type.

bounded.description: A one-sided bound. operator is lt or gt; value is the magnitude (e.g. lt with 0.5 means <0.5).

type.description: One of numeric, bounded, qualitative, text, absent.

items.description: One reference range. type describes the range, not a verdict on the result.

context.description: The patient dimensions a reference range is scoped by.

source.description: The verbatim provenance layer — what the report literally printed.

flag.description: Verbatim flag; the coded form is under interpretation.

200.description: A list of lab report sessions.
